chapter: The levee club and the St. Louis scene
title: Green leaves when a fight starts
summary: The levee club owner Green was a "scaredy cat" who grabbed the money when fights began but came back to pay the band.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: In a way. It's got to be. Different people. ... and I wouldn't compare anybody with anybody because it's that expression. And I think expression is a tremendous thing. Now, during that time I was working on the levee there and somebody had decided -- I think Green. Green was a scaredy cat.
Well, Green is the man that owned the place?
Yeah. Any time that a fight would start, Green would we'd grab the money and go home.
